objective: Increase trustworthiness of the native 4K Cinematic/Lighting/Material evidence by enforcing one and only one linear-to-sRGB display transfer on every canonical still without claiming visual quality before real pixels exist.

problemFound.summary: The existing HDR runtime receipt proved three HDR sources, three LDR destinations and no fallback, while the 4K capture source configured its non-HDR targets as sRGB. However, there was no independent fail-closed render-time guard requiring the actual canonical MainCamera target to report RenderTexture.sRGB=true on hero, oblique and grazing. A future descriptor/color-space drift could therefore produce linear-coded LDR PNG evidence or a duplicated gamma transfer while still looking structurally valid to unrelated geometry/material gates.
problemFound.whyItMatters: Incorrect display transfer changes apparent exposure, color, shadow separation, highlight rolloff and dielectric/metal response across the entire frame, so it can invalidate Cinematic Image, Lighting and Material/PBR judgments even when geometry is unchanged.

changes: Added an InitializeOnLoad MainCamera pre-cull guard scoped only to QA4K_hero_MSAA, QA4K_oblique_MSAA and QA4K_grazing_MSAA.

Requires Linear project color space, exact 3840x2160 target dimensions, a non-HDR final camera target, RenderTexture.sRGB=true, HDR-enabled camera path, dynamic resolution off, one enabled QualityBlockFilmicTonemap and ImageEffectTransformsToLDR.
Requires the canonical still order hero -> oblique -> grazing so an interrupted/mixed capture epoch cannot silently pass the new guard.

On any failure disables the mandatory filmic tonemap before rethrowing, preventing the existing exact-invocation HDR runtime receipt from later sealing the packet if a Unity callback exception does not abort Camera.Render immediately.
Added source-binding checks proving that the MSAA and single-sample resolve descriptors inherit the same Linear-project sRGB intent and that final readback is from the resolved target.

Added source-binding checks that the filmic shader consumes scene-linear values and contains no explicit LinearToGammaSpace/GammaToLinearSpace/manual pow-based gamma encoding; the sRGB target owns the single output encoding step.
Added machine-readable Linear HDR -> linear filmic LDR -> sRGB target policy.
Documented canonical target names/order, 3840x2160 requirement, resolve descriptor inheritance, failure behavior, zero automatic visual points and Unity-runtime-pending status.
Recorded Unity 6 documentation references for RenderTextureReadWrite, RenderTexture.sRGB and GL.sRGBWrite semantics.

issuesFoundAndCorrected: The first implementation revision incorrectly searched QualityBlockFilmicTonemap.cs for the shader-local token 'sceneLinear'. That would have failed source preflight unconditionally. The follow-up commit moved the sceneLinear/AcesApprox checks to NewTownFilmicTonemap.shader and checks the component for its real OnRenderImage signature instead.
staticBindingsVerified: QualityBlock4KCapture.cs contains ARGB32 native descriptors, Linear-project sRGB descriptor assignment, resolveDescriptor inheritance, single-sample resolve, resolvedTarget readback and RGB24 PNG staging.
QualityBlockFilmicTonemap.cs contains ImageEffectTransformsToLDR, OnRenderImage, the material blit and source/destination sRGB telemetry properties.
NewTownFilmicTonemap.shader contains sceneLinear and AcesApprox(sceneLinear * _ExposureMultiplier) and does not contain the forbidden explicit gamma helper tokens covered by the guard.

researchBasis.finding: In Linear color space, ordinary non-HDR color render textures can use sRGB read/write conversion, while floating-point HDR formats are always treated as linear data.
RenderTexture.sRGB exposes whether the render texture uses sRGB read/write conversion and can therefore be checked on the actual authoritative camera target.

In Linear color space, fragment outputs are linear and non-HDR sRGB targets perform Linear-to-sRGB conversion; Unity recommends correct RenderTexture color-space flags rather than ad-hoc state switching.

expectedVisualScoreImpact: Cinematic image quality/composition/color/exposure (5): prevents canonical PNG evidence from silently omitting the Linear-to-sRGB output transfer or receiving a second manual gamma encoding. No point is awarded until actual pixels are reviewed.
Lighting/shadows/reflections (15): preserves trustworthy highlight/shadow appearance for the existing physical sun, sky and reflection evidence; does not prove those pixels are visually good.
Material/PBR physical plausibility (20): keeps roughness/specular/Fresnel judgments from being made on color-transfer-corrupted display values; does not clear any material critical defect.
nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime remains the gating blocker. On first Runner availability, stop speculative expansion, compile the new InitializeOnLoad guard, run the complete native-4K packet, prove hero/oblique/grazing targets report sRGB=true while the image-effect source remains floating-point HDR, then inspect the sealed 3840x2160 frames and 100% crops for actual exposure, rolloff, clipping, color and material response before assigning any Visual Fidelity points.
readinessNote: Implementation Readiness remains 93/100 because this run strengthens formal evidence plumbing but does not supply the missing 7-point Unity compile/runtime verification.
